tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Find products in this catalogue by free text and/or category. Returns mpn, title, page URL and category for each match. The mpn is what get_product and get_quote take.

query.description: Free text matched against the product title, case-insensitive. Omit to list everything (optionally narrowed by category).

category.description: Taxonomy term id to filter by. Read the category tree from the dinilu://categories resource.

limit.description: Maximum results to return. Default 50, maximum 200.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Get a product's configurable attributes and their options, plus its minimum order quantity and quantity step. Call this before get_quote: the attribute and option ids it returns are what get_quote expects.

mpn.description: Product MPN, from search_products or from the mpn field in a product page's JSON-LD.

tools.name: get_quote
tools.description: Price a specific configuration and quantity, with production time and shipping options. Indicative, excludes VAT and shipping, never binding. Read the returned "warnings" before presenting the price.

qty.description: Quantity in PIECES. Below the product minimum it is raised to the MOQ and a qty_below_minimum warning is returned. Omitting it quotes the product default and warns — always pass the real target quantity, because price per piece changes substantially with volume.

attributes.description: Option selection as {"<attribute id>": <option id>}, e.g. {"19": 251, "58": 490}. Both ids come from get_product. Option NAMES are also accepted as values but must match exactly, including double spaces, and are translated per domain — prefer ids. Any attribute you omit is filled with the product default and reported in warnings.

country.description: Destination country for shipping rates. Accepts a name ("Germany"), ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 ("DE"), alpha-3 ("DEU") or numeric ("276"). Defaults to this domain's country.

zone.description: Optional zone/state id, where shipping rates depend on it.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Compatibility search for research clients that require a tool named "search". Returns only id, title and URL. Prefer search_products, which also filters by category and returns the category of each hit.

query.description: Free text matched against the product title.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Compatibility fetch for research clients that require a tool named "fetch". Returns one product as readable text. It carries NO price: prices depend on quantity and options and come from get_quote.

id.description: The id returned by search (the product mpn, as a string).
